connectionString.label: MongoDB connection string
connectionString.help: Paste the complete MongoDB URI. Atlas example: mongodb+srv://<username>:<password>@iobroker-data.s8yl5.mongodb.net/iobroker. Encode reserved URI characters in usernames and passwords.

aggregationPipeline.label: MongoDB aggregation JSON
aggregationPipeline.help: Enter a MongoDB aggregation pipeline as a JSON array. It runs for each newly stored document. Input fields: _id, id, ts, val, ack, q, from. Keep _id in the output.

aggregationCollection.label: Mapped output collection
aggregationCollection.help: Transformed documents are written here. The regular history collection keeps the original ioBroker fields for history queries.
